items.title: Stale + hermetic test fixes: authority-job-loop-live (rebuild-verify), autopilot-authority (assertion update), multi-host-authority (no-op fileReader isolation)
items.context:
GROUND TRUTH established by running each smoke from repo-root cwd vs /tmp clean cwd on a fresh build (npm --prefix packages/main run build).

(1) authority-job-loop-live: PASSES standalone exit 0 on a fresh build (stale-dist artifact; commit 3a0199f79 already realigned it). Fix = rebuild + verify ONLY. Do NOT edit it; do NOT env-gate it.

(2) autopilot-authority: CORRECTED FIX (triage prescription was WRONG). It FAILS from repo-root cwd with actual="pass" expected="warn" and PASSES from /tmp. Root cause is NON-HERMETIC (identical to multi-host): the dev on-disk authority_trust.env (LATTICE_AUTHORITY_LIVE_URL=https://staging.hostneutral.net) leaks into shadow mode because buildAuthorityStatus reads authority_trust.env via fileReader from cwd, and for shadow mode enabled=true so the trust-env URL is consumed -> authorityUrlConfigured=true -> no URL-empty warning -> status=pass. PRODUCTION IS CORRECT: authority-mode.ts:446-452 applies the localhost DEFAULT_AUTHORITY_URL ONLY to enforce mode; shadow keeps no-URL behavior, so shadow.status===warn with empty env is the correct intended behavior. DO NOT change the assertion to pass / readinessWarnings===0 (that would WEAKEN a valid assertion AND break the smoke from a clean cwd / CI). CORRECT FIX = make the smoke hermetic: pass {fileReader: () => undefined} into the buildAuthorityStatus / buildAuthorityEnforceRunnerPlan calls inside buildAutopilotRun path used by autopilot-authority-smoke.ts (AuthorityStatusRuntime extends AuthorityConfigLoadOptions which has optional fileReader). KEEP all existing assertions including shadow.status===warn and readinessWarnings.length>0, localWorkflowUsable===true, authorityRequired===false. Test-only override knob; 0 production change.

(3) multi-host-authority: NON-HERMETIC (as triaged). FAILS from repo-root with actual=server expected=local, PASSES from /tmp. Fix = pass {fileReader: () => undefined} into the ~14 resolveAuthorityVerdictBacking/loadAuthorityConfig env-only call sites so disk reads return nothing -> hermetic regardless of dev authority_trust.env. 0 production change.

NEVER weaken an assertion to pass. Each smoke must pass standalone from BOTH repo-root cwd and /tmp after the fix (the hermetic fix must make cwd irrelevant).

items.title: Timeout bumps for the 5 genuinely-slow P5 smokes in smoke-manifest.json
items.context: VERIFIED current manifest state: packages/main/smoke-manifest.json ALREADY has raised timeouts for all 5 — dispatch-run=180000, lattice-baseline=240000, cli-json-stdout-contract=180000, planner-unattended=180000, experience-layer-playbook=180000 (all real, finite ceilings, not infinite). So this item is primarily RE-VERIFY, not re-bump. Task: (a) confirm each value is >= measured-standalone-time + margin (re-measure each standalone wall time; bump only if a value is still too tight under parallel suite load — keep a REAL finite ceiling, never infinity); (b) run npm run test:all and confirm none of the 5 TIMEOUT under suite load and the full suite reaches its green target (~162/162 modulo genuine env skips). Do NOT change smoke logic. If a value already gives ample headroom and test:all shows no timeout, leave it (no gratuitous bumping).
items.userSees: Running `npm run test:all`, the 5 previously-timing-out P5 smokes complete within their raised timeouts and PASS; the full suite reaches ~162/162 (modulo any genuinely-environmental skips), with no smoke logic changed and a real (non-infinite) timeout ceiling preserved.
